related_malicious_code_snippet: Marak decided to make a statement about open source sustainability, or the lack thereof. The maintainer opened an issue in his GitHub repository stating that they will not be doing any more free work.

On January 5th, 2022, the maintainer published a new version of the Faker.js npm package that includes a semantic version number of 6.6.6, such that faker@6.6.6 is a valid version to be downloaded from the npm registry. The new 6.6.6 version completely removed all traces of the original source code of the Faker.js npm package.
